forward_looking.speaker: Kevan Parekh
forward_looking.statement: We expect our June quarter total company revenue to grow by 14%–17% year-over-year, which comprehends our best view of constrained supply.

forward_looking.speaker: Kevan Parekh
forward_looking.statement: We expect gross margin to be between 47.5% and 48.5%.

forward_looking.speaker: Tim Cook
forward_looking.statement: We expect significantly higher memory costs. They are also partly offset by the benefit of carry-in inventory.

forward_looking.speaker: Tim Cook
forward_looking.statement: We believe memory costs will drive an increasing impact on our business. We'll look at a range of options.

forward_looking.speaker: Tim Cook
forward_looking.statement: The Mac mini and the Mac Studio may take several months to reach supply-demand balance.

forward_looking.speaker: Tim Cook
forward_looking.statement: We look forward to bringing a more personalized Siri to users coming this year.

forward_looking.speaker: Kevan Parekh
forward_looking.statement: We believe AI is a really important investment area for Apple, and we're going to be doing that incrementally on top of what we normally invest in our product roadmap.

forward_looking.speaker: Kevan Parekh
forward_looking.statement: We expect services revenue to grow at a year-over-year rate similar to what we reported in the March quarter after removing the favorable year-over-year impact from foreign exchange tailwinds.
